text:
maria: Quick sanity check on onboarding 'orchid-lite' (our compact multilingual embed) to staging — cross-lang recall@10 down ~8% vs falcon-embed-v2 baseline on the 10k holdout.

devin: can you paste numbers?

maria: Baseline falcon-embed-v2 (fp16):
- recall@10: 0.732
- recall@50: 0.911
- median_norm: 0.98

orchid-lite fp16 (staging):
- recall@10: 0.703 (-2.9%)
- recall@50: 0.905 (-0.7%)
- median_norm: 0.95

orchid-lite int4 per-channel (quantized):
- recall@10: 0.661 (-9.7%)
- recall@50: 0.882 (-3.2%)
- median_norm: 0.86

sam: looks like norm compression after quantization => cosine shift. ran a quick check: normalizing embeddings before similarity restores ~0.02 recall@10 but not full gap.

devin: command I used:
```
rdw-eval run --model orchid-lite --holdout multilang-10k --quant int4 --metric recall@10,recall@50 --output /tmp/orchid-int4.json
```

evalbot: quick diff (baseline vs int4): recall@10 delta = -0.071; mean cosine shift = -0.048; cluster purity (k=10) drop = -3.4%

maria: visualized UMAP — clusters still separate for English but many non-en nodes from RU/JP collapse toward center; suspect embedding norm interacts with per-token vocab quantization for subword-heavy languages.

keith: can try per-sample l2 renormalize + temperature rescale before index. small script:
```
# renorm + scale
E = np.load('embs.npy')
E = E / np.linalg.norm(E, axis=1, keepdims=True)
E = E * 1.03  # tune
```

sam: also try whitening transform fitted on holdout (PCA -> sphering) — reduces cross-lang bias in our past experiments.

maria: plan: 1) devin run renorm+scale sweep (0.98-1.08) on int4; 2) sam test whitening pipeline; 3) keith run corpus-level per-lang norm histograms and send plots. I'll open a staging rollout hold until we confirm.

devin: starting renorm sweep now, will share /tmp/orchid-renorm-sweep.csv in ~30m :thumbsup:

sam: if renorm helps we should add post-quant normalization to the quantization CI to avoid regressions.

maria: agreed — tagging infra/ops to add a quick check. thanks team :rocket:
